release.summary: Owner-preview analysis reads need the server secret; the bulk Convex reads nothing calls are internal; listActiveRecords needs the secret for every work; two react-hooks resets.
release.reviewFindings: GPT-6.2 Sol (xhigh): #524 approved in 1 round. #525 took 3 rounds: its first version capped rows, which still allowed multi-MB replies and would have repeated generation numbers past 200 pictures. It was rebuilt to make uncalled reads internal, and getBooksWithImages was added in round 3. #523 lost its F22 and F23 fixes, which Sol showed opened worse failures (a possible double charge during rollout; unsent Nostr posts recorded as published); both are deferred. CodeRabbit skipped every PR (hourly limit). CI quality-gates passed on all.

steps.convex: Production unique-impala-244 from main 6d252958. Dry run first: no index deletions, schema valid, and the known blank 'Node.js actions' line.

steps.commit: 6d252958 (main; since production's df77402d it adds only #521-#525)

smoke.before: Anonymous calls on the production Convex URL to verseImages:getBooksWithImages, analysis:getWorkStatus for holmes-adventures, and analysis:listActiveRecords for bible-web sections all returned success.
smoke.after: The same three calls are refused, while anonymous analysis:getWorkStatus for bible-web still succeeds. /genesis/1/1, /john/3/16, /about, /api/health, /.well-known/nostr.json and /api/image-models answer 200, / redirects, and POST then GET /api/session works. Headless Chromium on /genesis/1/1 renders the verse picture from Convex storage with no failed Convex request.
smoke.notRegressions: A first visit logs one 401 from POST /api/chat/quote: the quote is requested before the session cookie exists, and the second load gets 200. No chat code changed in this release.
smoke.notExercised: Owner preview pages (admin-only) were not opened.

rollback.convex: Push the functions from df77402d. Old Next code works against the new Convex functions except owner-preview analysis reads, which then need the secret it does not send.
